schemes: PMEGP (PM's Employment Generation Programme)
Credit support for setting up or expanding a micro unit.
Artisans, SHGs and individual entrepreneurs with a viable project plan.
Subsidy of 15-35% on project cost plus credit support.
Apply through kviconline.gov.in or at a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar, PAN and a project report.
https://www.kviconline.gov.in/pmegpportal/
Mudra Yojana - Tarun Plus
Collateral-free loans for small and micro enterprises.
Any individual, partnership or firm engaged in a non-farm income-generating activity.
Loan up to 10 lakh rupees with no collateral and a longer repayment period.
Apply through a bank, NBFC or MUDRA portal with Aadhaar and a business plan.
https://www.mudra.org.in/
SME Tailor Made Package for Export
Support for packaging and branding help for small exporters.
Registered MSME units making handicraft or textile goods.
Reimbursement of packaging development and branding costs.
Apply through the concerned office of the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) or the portal.
https://handicrafts.nic.in/
NHDC Marketing Assistance Scheme
Help with product photography, catalogues and fair participation.
Registered craft producers and artisans.
Subsidy for participation in national and international fairs.
Register with an empanelled emporium and apply through the NHDC or the office of the Development Commissioner.
https://handicrafts.nic.in/
PM Mudra Yojana - Kishor
Small loans for first-time young entrepreneurs.
Individuals aged 18-35 starting a new enterprise in manufacturing, trading or services.
Loan up to 5 lakh rupees.
Apply at any bank branch with Aadhaar, PAN and a project report.
https://www.mudra.org.in/
Stand-Up India - SC/ST and Women Entrepreneurs
Greenfield manufacturing projects with bank credit.
SC, ST and women entrepreneurs in manufacturing.
Bank loan between 10 lakh and 1 crore rupees.
Apply on the Stand-Up Mitra portal with Aadhaar and a project report.
https://www.standupmitra.in/
PM-KUSUM - Component A (Small Solar Power)
Support for solar pump sets for farmers and rural producers.
Individual farmers and groups in solar-lit areas.
Subsidy of 30% and concessional loans for solar equipment.
Apply at the state renewable energy development agency.
https://mnre.gov.in/
National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
Scholarship support so the next generation of artisans can study.
Families of artisans registered with a craft body, with income below the state limit.
Scholarship of up to 12,000 rupees a year.
Apply on the National Scholarship Portal with income and category certificates.
https://scholarships.gov.in/
One Stop Centre for Entrepreneurs
Free guidance and registration help for new businesses.
Any aspiring entrepreneur in a recognised district centre.
Free advisory, registration help and skill matching.
Walk into a District Resource Centre or call the state helpline.
https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/osc
GeM Artisan Seller Registration
Sell handicrafts directly to government buyers.
Any registered artisan or craft cooperative with GST or Udyam registration.
Direct access to government purchase orders.
Register on gem.gov.in as a seller with Udyam or GST documents.
https://gem.gov.in/
